U.A. General Studies.name: U.A. General Studies
U.A. General Studies.description:
📚 You follow a full academic program at U.A. in Class 1-C, 1-D or 1-E, on the same campus as the future heroes.

🎯 The Sports Festival is open to every course: a strong showing there can earn you a transfer into the Hero Course.
⚖️ No license: Quirk use is legal only in supervised physical education and in self-defense.
🤝 Many classmates failed the Hero Course exam, and some still want in, Hitoshi Shinso of 1-C most of all.
🏫 Lectures, clubs and exams fill your week, and you live in the Heights Alliance dorms with a curfew.
🔓 Learnable later: Replay Study, Breakout Showing.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Academics +10, Insight +10, Willpower +5
⚡ Starting technique: Just Another Student
🎒 Starts with: U.A. school uniform, U.A. gym uniform, U.A. student ID, Course textbooks, ¥10,000, School bag, Casual clothes
U.A. General Studies.traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: adult first-year, General Studies, Class 1-C, 1-D or 1-E. No hero license: Quirk use legal only in supervised PE and self-defense.
Access: campus, lecture halls, library, cafeteria, clubs, gyms; Hero Course facilities only as visitor or spectator.
Obligations: full academic load, exams, clubs; Heights Alliance dorms from day one, curfew.
Sports Festival: open to all, broadcast nationwide; going far can earn a Hero Course transfer review; weak Hero Course students can be moved out. Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head) and other Hero Course teachers scout there.
Who notices: General Studies teachers and classmates; the Hero Course mostly not until the Festival.
Standing pressures: many classmates failed the Hero Course exam and resent its spotlight; some, Hitoshi Shinso of 1-C most of all, still mean to get in. Hero Course news arrives as rumor first.
Typical week: lectures, a club, a job or family duties, hero news, solo training if aiming higher.
